list._baseAcceptanceValue: actor will always accept when their own AI decide to go to sleep, so this value is only checked if they were invited by someone else to sleep. Currently they'll lose consciousness when touching bed, but in the future i would like to extend this command into masturbation sex command or straight up sex. Instead of making them unable to act for the whole duration, make it so they'll prefer to stay in bed but nothing stops them from having sex or toilet or wander into someone else's room. or make it so their sleep consciousness mod fluctuate

variants._comments: sleep together - also 'sleep with' the bed's sleepers (Job_Furniture.MakePackages puts them as receivers, Docs/Furniture/Plan_FurnitureOccupancy.md). doerCount above 9 = no actor count limit, the bed's capacity is the limit

list._comments: going into a room divider (stall, private bathroom) - added by code to every furniture whose occupancy isRoomDivider (Job_Furniture.UpdateAllUsableCOMs), offered only from outside. Inside, the divider's own commands are reachable and the rest of the room is not. Temporary transit step (ActionPackage_DividerMove); the effect is applied on completion by the dividerEnter tag. The player's move is never refused: followers are its receivers (one who can't come stops following, named in the tooltip / log), a current target not following is first asked along with a real 同行 resolved on click - its rate is the command's rate. Docs/Furniture/Plan_FurnitureOccupancy.md §4

coming out of a room divider - offered only from inside, not while in a sex scene. Moving to another room needs it first (always explicit). Same mechanics as com_furniture_divider_enter (followers, 同行 invite).
all COM with sleep tag are hard-coded to allow character without sleep need to recover 1HP and 1MP on command completion
all COM with sleep tag are hard-coded to allow character without sleep need to recover 1HP and 1MP on command completion

Bed rest compelled by an abnormal condition (labor, post-birth / post-op recovery). Only valid while the doer requireBedRest. Pure time advance, no stat results. Natural birth only happens while the mother is executing a rest_required or rest COM (ReproductionUtility.CanBirthNow). Tags match beds' comTags [furniture, bed]; non-tag beds (hospital, netcafe) list it by comID. Beds only - never add it to tables/sofas.

list._comment: always usable (Docs/Body/Plan_InternalFluidFlow.md): redresses, then OnFixClothesDeflate offers to spit out the mouth's contents and washes the face; nothing to do -> a plain 'fixed clothes and took a breather' line. NPCs come here when undressed or with traces on the head (TryFindRedressNode).

put a character into cryosleep. Not offered itself: every cryo furniture gets its own child <ID>_<furniture> (COM_Character_Insert adds the cryo tags), which prints this command's text ($furniture$ = that furniture) and tries its own kojo first, then this command's

wake a character from cryosleep. Not offered itself: every cryo furniture gets its own child <ID>_<furniture> (COM_Character_Remove turns these add mechanics into the release: content must exist, lock undone, a 'release all' variant), which prints this command's text and tries its own kojo first, then this command's

lock a character in place in this prison furniture (Docs/Prison/Plan_PrisonRework.md §6 - was 'imprison' before the rework; imprisoning is com_prison_imprison now). Restraint (container + furniture lock) plus a MemberType override inside the furniture's faction while locked, chosen by the question (ActionPackage_Prison, tag prison_lock). No acceptance check. Not offered itself: every prison furniture gets its own child <ID>_<furniture> (COM_Character_Insert adds the prison tags), which prints this command's text ($furniture$ = that furniture) and tries its own kojo first, then this command's

unlock characters locked in this prison furniture (Docs/Prison/Plan_PrisonRework.md §6 - was 'release' before the rework; releasing a prisoner is com_prison_release now). The lock's MemberType override ends with it (Result_LockChara.Unlock). No acceptance check. Not offered itself: every prison furniture gets its own child <ID>_<furniture> (COM_Character_Remove turns these add mechanics into the unlock: content must exist, lock undone, an 'unlock all' variant), which prints this command's text and tries its own kojo first, then this command's

imprison the target on this prison furniture (Docs/Prison/Plan_PrisonRework.md §6). Offered by furniture giving comTags [furniture, prison] (the prison furniture). The click asks first (ActionPackage_Prison / PrisonCommand, event Prison_Command): a prisoner of the furniture's faction only moves to this cell; anyone else - which MemberType (imprisonOption types, 'no' = cancel), and a conscious, mobile target may refuse it. On completion the target gets that MemberType (PrisonUtility.Imprison: in place at their home, else this faction becomes their temporary home) and this bed as their cell. No acceptance check, no container lock (that is lock in place).

release a prisoner of one of the player's factions (Docs/Prison/Plan_PrisonRework.md §6). A character command in the dialogue tab, like 携带 (the prisoner may be anywhere). The click asks first (ActionPackage_Prison / PrisonCommand, event Prison_Command): release as a releaseOption type, recruit as one (isMember types: that faction becomes their permanent home) or send home ('no' = cancel). Applied on completion (PrisonUtility.Release); the cell goes. Invalid on anyone who isn't such a prisoner.

Revived from the stripped placeholder com_job_training_shooting (do_not_use, COM_job.json) as a location-agnostic recreation command (Docs/Utnapishtim_Activities/Plan_UtnapishtimActivities.md §6): any furniture giving comTags [furniture, training_shooting] offers it (furniture_shooting_range_spot), usable in normal sandbox anywhere; the house activity 'shooting_training' finds its lanes by this tag (RecreationFacility.comTag). Solo or pair. No experience yet: experience_combat has no ExperienceClass entry (ExperienceDefs/Experiences.json).

Revived from the stripped placeholder com_job_training_melee (see com_furniture_training_shooting): given by comTags [furniture, training_melee] (furniture_arena_spot). doerCount 1 = solo practice, 2 = sparring with a partner. No experience yet (experience_combat has no ExperienceClass entry).

Music practice on any furniture giving comTags [furniture, music_practice] (furniture_stage) - solo or a band, usable in normal sandbox anywhere; the house activity 'music_practice' holds the stage's whole room (RecreationFacility reserve Room). No experience yet (experience_perform has no ExperienceClass entry).

A physical checkup: the doer examines the receiver, on any furniture giving comTags [furniture, medical_checkup] (furniture_hospital_bed). No effect of its own. Sandbox only - the checkup activity's Job_Checkup runs its own job command (checkup_examination, COM_Defs/COM_Recreation/checkup.json - like jp_hospital_csection_operation). Not a recreation command.

en-us.com_furniture_sleep:
Sleep. Can be executed only during sleep hours (for Player, default value is 23H-6H, can be confirmed in Player Schedules in Management-Work Assignment tab)
On execution, every participant will fall into sleep status with duration equal to %%stats_derived_sleepNeed%% in minutes, and will wake up on status removal
en-us.com_furniture_sleep_begin_2: $doer.firstname$ turned off the bedside lamp and slowly closed their eyes
en-us.com_furniture_rest_required: Only available when the character must stay on bed rest (labor, postpartum or post-op recovery)
en-us.com_furniture_cryosleep_remove_begin_1: $doer.firstname$ begins waking $receiver.firstname$ from cryosleep in the $furniture$
en-us.com_furniture_cryosleep_remove_ongoing_1: $doer.firstname$ is ending the cryosleep in the $furniture$
en-us.com_prison_imprison: Imprison the target, with this as their cell
en-us.com_furniture_restroom_fix:
Can always be performed. Target will redress everything on command completion.
Optionally spits out expellable contents (such as semen) from the mouth, and washes the traces off the face.
NPC will try to find a suitable spot first (a restroom, or a bedroom dresser) when undressed or with traces on the face.
en-us.com_furniture_getmeal_begin_1: $doer.firstname$ sat down at the table, picked up a portion of $name$ and began to eat.
en-us.com_furniture_getmeal_begin_2: $doer.firstname$ brought the $name$ closer and began eating.
en-us.com_furniture_takingBreak: Take a break to relieve character stress
en-us.com_furniture_takingLongBreak: Relieves character stress and recovers HP, at the cost of double the time
en-us.com_furniture_prison_ADD: Lock the target in place here (unable to leave this room); while locked they count as the chosen standing
en-us.com_furniture_prison_REMOVE: Unlock the target locked here; they return to their own standing
